```{r combinine data all up and down votes, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#function that reads scsconda output files and binds them into one tibble
make_df <- function(rel_path_folder=".\\python\\", pattern="mild_vs_control.csv"){
  files_names<- list.files(rel_path_folder) %>% str_subset(pattern) %>% paste0(rel_path_folder,.)
  files_names%>%
  #create alist of tibbles of the scConda results
  map(read_csv) %>%
  #add a column to each tibble with the comparison of the table
  map2(files_names,~mutate(.x, comparison=.y)) %>% 
  #merge all into one dataframe
  map_df(~bind_rows(.x))
  
}

#pipe function that summaries the aggregated scCoda tibble into how many of the comparisons were up or downregulated
sum_up_down <- . %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  select(covariate,cell_type,final_parameter) %>% 
  mutate(up=ifelse(final_parameter>0,1,0),
         down=ifelse(final_parameter<0,1,0)) %>% 
  group_by(cell_type) %>% 
  summarise(sum_up=sum(up), sum_down=sum(down)) %>% 
  mutate(sum_down=-sum_down) %>% 
  #long format for plotting
  pivot_longer(cols = sum_up:sum_down,names_to = "up_down") %>%
  #actually this is not needed as no there are no cellt ypes that have both  negative and positive entries
  #however 0 values are duplicated and will over plot the other values, removed later
  #filter(up_down!="sum_up" | value!=0) %>% 
  #factor for non-continous scale for plotting
  mutate(majority=ifelse(abs(value)>6,"majority","minority"),value= factor(value,levels =c(-13:13) )
         )



##side by side
df_mild_vs_control_up_down <- make_df() %>% sum_up_down %>% mutate(comparison="mild_vs_control")
df_severe_vs_control_up_down <- make_df(pattern="severe_vs_control.csv")%>% sum_up_down%>% mutate(comparison="severe_vs_control")
df_severe_vs_mild_up_down <- make_df(pattern="severe_vs_mild.csv")%>% sum_up_down%>% mutate(comparison="severe_vs_mild")
df_mild_vs_control_up_down
df_severe_vs_control_up_down
df_severe_vs_mild_up_down
```


```{r combinine and clean data summation of votes, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#votes are in one variable because they are mutually elusive
#pipe function that summaries the aggregated scCoda tibble into how many of the comparisons were up or down regulated
sum_vote <- . %>% 
  clean_names() %>%
  select(covariate,cell_type,final_parameter)%>% 
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarize(vote=ifelse(final_parameter>0,1,
                     ifelse(final_parameter<0,-1,0))) %>%
  group_by(cell_type) %>%
  summarise(sum_vote_same_as_value=sum(vote)) %>%
  #factor for non-continuous scale for plotting
  mutate(majority=ifelse(abs(sum_vote_same_as_value)>6,"majority","minority"),
         value= factor(sum_vote_same_as_value,levels =c(-13:13) ))

#only one value
df_mild_vs_control <-make_df() %>% sum_vote %>% mutate(comparison="mild_vs_control")
df_severe_vs_control <- make_df(pattern="severe_vs_control.csv")%>% sum_vote%>% mutate(comparison="severe_vs_control")
df_severe_vs_mild <- make_df(pattern="severe_vs_mild.csv")%>% sum_vote%>% mutate(comparison="severe_vs_mild")
df_mild_vs_control
df_severe_vs_control
df_severe_vs_mild
```
```{r plot, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#set colours for plots
pal <- colorRampPalette(c("blue","white", "red"))
sccoda_tiles <- function(x){x %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=comparison,y=cell_type, fill=value,color=majority)) +
    geom_tile(size=2, width=0.7, height=0.7) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values =pal(27),labels=as.character(-13:13), drop=FALSE)+
    scale_color_manual(values=c("minority"="grey", "majority"="black"))}


###set theme
theme_main <-   theme(axis.text.y=element_blank(),  #remove y axis labels
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),  #remove y axis ticks
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text( size = 12,hjust = 0.5),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "null"))

theme_left <-   theme(
  #########################################axis.text.y=element_blank(),  #remove y axis labels
        axis.ticks.y=element_blank(),  #remove y axis ticks
        axis.title.y=element_blank(),
        axis.title.x=element_blank(),
        plot.title = element_text( size = 12,hjust = 0.5),
        panel.background = element_blank(),
        panel.border = element_blank(),
        strip.background = element_blank(),
        plot.background = element_blank(),
        axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 90, vjust = 0.5, hjust=1),
        plot.margin = unit(c(0,0,0,0), "null")
        )
#create plots
p1 <- df_mild_vs_control %>% sccoda_tiles +theme_left + labs(title = "mild\nvs.\ncontrol")
p2 <- df_severe_vs_control %>% sccoda_tiles +theme_main + labs(title = "severe\nvs.\ncontrol") +theme()
p3 <- df_severe_vs_mild %>% sccoda_tiles + theme_main + labs(title = "severe\nvs.\nmild")

p1+plot_spacer()+p2+plot_spacer()+p3+ plot_layout(guides = "collect")+plot_layout(widths = c(4,-1.8, 4,-1.8,4),guides = "collect")+theme(plot.margin = unit(c(-1,-1,-1,-1), "cm"))

p1+p2+p3+plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```
```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

sccoda_tiles_up_down <- function(x){x %>% 
  ggplot(aes(x=up_down,y=cell_type, fill=value,color=majority)) +
    geom_tile(size=2, width=0.7, height=0.7) + 
    scale_fill_manual(values =pal(27),labels=as.character(-13:13), drop=FALSE)+
    scale_color_manual(values=c("minority"="grey", "majority"="black"))}


p4 <- df_mild_vs_control_up_down %>% sccoda_tiles_up_down +theme_left + labs(title = "mild\nvs.\ncontrol")
p5 <- df_severe_vs_control_up_down %>% sccoda_tiles_up_down +theme_main + labs(title = "severe\nvs.\ncontrol")
p6 <- df_severe_vs_mild_up_down %>% sccoda_tiles_up_down +theme_main+ labs(title = "severe\nvs.\nmild")

p4+p5+p6+ plot_layout(guides = "collect")
```
